page.overview:
Who is Q.A. Melton?

Q.A. Melton was an employee of the San Francisco Fleet Yards in the 23rd century when was being built. Rayner and Michael Burnham encountered him briefly while affected by the Krenim chronophage.

He mistook them for inspectors and was surprised to see them, as he thought the inspection was supposed to be tomorrow. He said he'd let the foreman know they were there, and advised them to head to deck seven last. Rayner told him to say that's where they were going next, adding, "Fail to prepare, prepare to fail, son."

Burnham noted that everyone they'd encountered, including Melton, were all living in the moment, unlike them. ()
